statement: With the real things in the real cabinets, everything goes where the plan puts it and the family finds it there
rationale: a plan made from typical sizes is a drawing; a drawer that takes the pans on paper may not close on their handles, and a plan nobody follows is not a plan

mechanism.how: When the cabinets are in: load each one from the plan, close every door and drawer, then ask each of the four to fetch five named things without help
